newsitem.title: UK: LS straight-run fuel oil up $2, Russian unchanged.
newsitem.headline: LS straight-run fuel oil up $2, Russian unchanged.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil rose $2.00 a tonne in northwest Europe but high sulphur Russian grades were little changed.
Dealers pegged north Sea grades around $140.00 fob NWE with one seller asking an ambitious $150 delivered.
Refinery buying was mostly subdued but Scandinavian interest for 0.4 percent sulphur for burning was close to current levels.

Meanwhile, high sulphur Russian cargoes asked anywhere from $116.00 to $124.00 cif Rotterdam depending on quality. But few buyers could take cargoes with high water content due to a lack of blending material, dealers said.
